Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.441.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '669ee74716476f47ff1d9302989820c7a2253a75ae2034ac0d73e2cd444751b9') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
